mapper.select: select count(*) as totalAssets, sum(case when status = 'ACTIVE' then 1 else 0 end) as activeAssets, sum(case when status = 'IDLE' then 1 else 0 end) as idleAssets, sum(case when status = 'MAINTENANCE' then 1 else 0 end) as maintenanceAssets, coalesce(sum(original_value), 0) as totalOriginalValue from asset

select a.id as assetId, a.asset_code as assetCode, a.name as assetName, count(r.id) as usageCount from asset_usage_record r inner join asset a on r.asset_id = a.id group by a.id, a.asset_code, a.name order by usageCount desc, a.id asc limit #{limit}
select c.id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName, count(a.id) as assetCount from asset_category c left join asset a on a.category_id = c.id group by c.id, c.name order by assetCount desc, c.id asc
